question: As of 2022 , there are _____ Union Territories of India.
solution:
The correct answer is __**8**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **As of 2022, there are 8 Union Territories in India.**
 
• **Historical changes:**
 
 
• The number of Union Territories in India has changed over time due to political and administrative decisions.
 
 
 
• **The Merger of Union Territories:**
 
 
• The Union territories of Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu were combined as one single union territory on 26th January 2020.
 
 
 
• **Creation of new Union Territories:**
 
 
• Ladakh was separated from Jammu and Kashmir and created as a separate Union Territory.
